title: Editable fields isolated from global performance mappings
summary: The repo audit confirmed one real window-level audio/performance keyboard map in app.js and one duplicate visual-feedback map in input_feedback_runtime.js. A delegated editable-field guard now preserves normal typing in input, textarea, select, and contenteditable targets while preventing note, pad, navigation, and transport events from bubbling to the global performance handler.

verification.targeted_browser: real KeyZ in PROJECT naming and KeyX in a generic textarea typed normally with no synth held-key leakage
